blocks.text: Let's look at this one. Which of these expressions have exactly three terms? Choose all that apply.
blocks.display: Select all the expressions with exactly three terms.

blocks.text: Two x squared minus five x plus one. Three pieces separated by signs. Three terms.
A minus b plus c. The pieces are a, negative b and c. Three terms.
Four times the quantity x plus one, minus seven. The group counts as one term, so there are only two terms.
Three x y plus two. Two terms. The x and the y are factors, not separate terms.
Negative x plus six minus four y. The first term starts with a minus sign, but it is still one term. Three terms in all.
Three expressions have exactly three terms. Count the pieces separated by plus and minus, and treat each group in parentheses as one piece.
